title: Internal: granting commercial goodwill on a demurrage invoice line
content:
## Scope

Under the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category, the desk may reduce a demurrage invoice line of a per-container record as commercial goodwill. This entry covers when goodwill on the demurrage line is granted and the internal tool that books it.

## When it applies

A commercial goodwill waiver on the demurrage line of a record is granted at the billed party's request.

> Goodwill on a record's demurrage charges is computed only on a demurrage invoice row already booked on that record.

In other words, before goodwill on demurrage can be handled, the record must already carry a booked demurrage invoice line; where it does not, no demurrage goodwill is computed or granted.

Goodwill on a detention invoice line remains governed by the general goodwill waiver rules alone.

## Business effect of the booking

- One goodwill waiver entry dated today is written on the free-time record, recorded with the reason commercial goodwill and pointing at the invoice line it reduces.
- The balance the billed party owes on the record is lowered by the amount waived.
- The customer then sees the waiver against that invoice line and the lower balance.

## How it is invoked

The tool is **grant_goodwill_waiver_e03c98b1**. It is an internal tool: the agent must first unlock it (unlock, through unlock_agent_discoverable_tool) and then call it (call, through call_agent_discoverable_tool).

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| dnd_id | Reference number of the free-time record carrying the invoice line, as returned by the free-time record lookup | identifier |
| customer_id | Customer reference number of the billed party, as returned by the customer profile lookup | identifier |
| reference_event_id | Invoice reference of the invoice line being reduced, as returned by the account entry lookup or by the receipt of the line's booking | identifier |
| amount_usd | Amount waived | USD, a positive figure given to 2 decimal places |

## Return

A successful booking answers "Goodwill waiver (waiver reference) of USD (amount) booked against invoice line (invoice reference) on record (record reference); balance due now USD (balance)." The balance is the record's outstanding amount in USD to 2 decimal places after the waiver. An answer starting with "Error:" means no record exists under that reference and nothing was booked.

## Points of judgement

**Q: A consignee asks for goodwill on demurrage, but the record has not yet been invoiced for demurrage. Can goodwill on demurrage be granted now?**
A: No. Demurrage goodwill is computed only on a demurrage invoice line already booked on the record.

**Q: The customer asks for goodwill on the detention line instead. Does this entry govern it?**
A: No. Goodwill on a detention line remains under the general goodwill waiver rules alone.
